redfin.remarks: Discover an exceptional opportunity in the heart of Santa Monica with this spacious top-floor 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo offering an impressive 959 square feet of comfortable living space. Set within an intimate 7-unit building, this residence also features remarkably low HOA dues of just $387 per month. Step inside to a bright and inviting interior featuring laminate flooring and a generous living room anchored by a decorative fireplace. A spacious walk-in coat closet provides excellent storage, while the adjoining enclosed balcony with expansive windows and track lighting creates a versatile bonus space ideal for a home office, reading retreat, or additional lounge area. The spacious kitchen is filled with natural light from a wide window and features stainless steel appliances, including a KitchenAid cooktop, refrigerator, microwave, oven, and dishwasher. Double sinks and a convenient breakfast counter with bar seating make the kitchen both functional and welcoming. The oversized bedroom offers plenty of room to unwind, along with shutters, crown molding, and a large connected closet with two access doors, providing abundant storage. The full bathroom features a wide vanity and a tub/shower combination with sliding glass doors. Adding to the convenience is the highly desirable in-unit stackable washer and dryer. Complete with one assigned parking space, this Santa Monica gem puts you moments from Bristol Farms, Trader Joe’s, Wilshire Boulevard, Santa Monica Boulevard, the Metro E Line, and an incredible selection of shopping, dining, entertainment, and everything the Westside has to offer.
